item.title: No Limits welcomes Deborah Wright to the show. Deborah is the new VP of Workforce/Economic Development.
item.description: No Limits welcomes Deborah Wright to the show. Deborah is the new VP of Workforce/Economic Development, Continuing Education. Be sure to listen in so that you can learn more about her and how she has been able to successfully step into an important leadership role in lieu of COVID-19. During the show, she will touch on all of the great things that her Division does for the economy, our workforce, and the life longer learner. What has been her biggest challenge? How does she envision the future?
